\begin{tablenotes}[flushleft]
\footnotesize
\item Coefficients are Bitcoin-specific interactions with six-month event-time bins relative to 2024m2, from a specification with coin and calendar-month fixed effects. The reference bin is $-2$, covering the six months ending at the donut, because the conventional $k=-1$ bin falls inside the excluded window. Bins rather than single months are used because a month-by-month specification is saturated for a single treated unit: Bitcoin's residual is identically zero in any month carrying its own dummy, so the standard errors would be computed off the control coins alone. Standard errors in parentheses are cluster-robust on coin. The joint pre-trend $F$-test is reported in both its asymptotic and its randomization form. The asymptotic version inherits the one-treated-unit problem and rejects for every coin in the panel, treated or not; the randomization version, obtained by casting each of the nine control coins in turn as the treated unit, is the valid test, and Bitcoin's statistic lies below the median placebo.
\end{tablenotes}
